name: incident_triage
title: An alert opens an incident, and the person on call triages it
description: When an alert opens an incident (a duplicate alert joins the open one instead), give the tenant's On-call role a triage task on the task list. The person who takes it resolves the incident or escalates it to an administrator. Installed as drafts: nothing runs until a person publishes the process and the recipe. Human tasks only: nothing here acts on its own.
